title: Flowers
description: Browse fresh flowers and best-selling arrangements hand-arranged by local Teleflora florists, with reusable catalog data for PLP, PDP, landing, and homepage modules.
seoTitle: Flower Delivery and Fresh Arrangements | Teleflora
seoDescription: Shop Teleflora-style flower delivery with fresh arrangements, local florist hand delivery, same-day options, and reusable product catalog data.

heroImage.alt: Fresh flower assortment arranged across a table

blocks.heading: Flowers arranged by local florists
blocks.bodyHtml: Teleflora-style flower pages can use the same product catalog across category grids, product detail pages, homepage rails, and campaign landing modules. Each arrangement keeps product IDs, pricing, variants, imagery, delivery messaging, SEO metadata, and related products in one reusable source.

blocks.heading: Same-day and occasion-led merchandising
blocks.bodyHtml: Products can be merchandised by occasion, color, flower type, price range, and campaign module while still resolving back to one product slug and PDP route.
